sources.cite: AWS Lambda Developer Guide, Lambda parameters for Amazon Kinesis Data Streams event source mappings
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: MaximumRetryAttempts default -1, '-1 means infinite: failed records are retried until the record expires'; MaximumRecordAgeInSeconds default -1; BisectBatchOnFunctionError default false; StartingPosition AT_TIMESTAMP, TRIM_HORIZON or LATEST; FunctionResponseTypes ReportBatchItemFailures. That LATEST reads only new records is general knowledge (to verify).

sources.cite: AWS Lambda Developer Guide, Retaining discarded batch records for a Kinesis Data Streams event source in Lambda
sources.note: Read directly on 2026-11-17 (German machine translation of the English page). Relevant text: when the function returns an error Lambda retries until the records expire, exceed MaximumRecordAgeInSeconds or reach MaximumRetryAttempts; BisectBatchOnFunctionError splits a failed batch in two to isolate bad records and splitting does not use up retries; 'with the default settings a bad record can block processing on the affected shard for up to one week'; an on-failure destination can be an SNS topic, SQS queue, S3 bucket or Kafka; for SQS and SNS Lambda sends only metadata (shardId, start and end sequence numbers), so the records must be read from the stream before they expire; for S3 it also sends the whole invocation record as payload.
